Prezzee — Digital gift cards

Mobile Fintech UI/UX

Prezzee replaces the plastic gift card with a digital one. The core question was how to get people onboarded, buying and gifting with as little friction as possible.

The result is a streamlined account creation flow feeding a simple browse-and-gift experience. Designed at Pollen.

Role

UI Designer

Deliverables

Onboarding flow

Mobile UI

Gifting experience
